messages:
rachel.sales: AuroraPSC requested a compliance bundle for the POC and asked whether we can allow their Qualys scan against staging. They also want SOC2 system description, ISO network diagram, signed pen-test acceptance, and confirmation on logging retention. Deadline: next Fri.

marc.se: Quick check  is this Hosted or Dedicated? If Dedicated / single-tenant we can give scanner IPs for a narrow window. Hosted we generally do not allow external active scans without a vendor agreement.

rachel.sales: They specifically asked for Dedicated isolation and said they need a 3-hour scan window during UAT.

celia.security: For Dedicated we can support a time-boxed external scan if the scope is limited to staging and we have an allowlist of scanner IPs. Requirements: (1) signed pen-test acceptance from customer, (2) SOW clause limiting impact, (3) ephemeral creds and rotate afterwards. Also need to confirm they won't request raw prompt exports.

rachel.sales: They said raw prompt export not required, but they might ask for sample prompts for redaction checks. Can we provide redacted snapshots?

marc.se: We can provide sanitized snapshots (hash + 80-char snippet) or a redaction pipeline. The latter is heavier. Recommend offering a small sample set under NDA.

theo.legal: I can sign the pen-test attestation once Security approves the scope. If AuroraPSC uses our template we can sign in 48 hours. If they send their own template with redlines, budget 3-5 business days. Also confirm the DPA covers sample prompt sharing.

ops-bot: presign/upload snippet for evidence bundle:
```bash
curl -X PUT "https://storage.redwood.example/evidence/aurorapsc/poc-bundle.zip?X-Amz-Signature=..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/zip" --data-binary @poc-bundle.zip
```

celia.security: Also: if they request SIEM forwarding (their Splunk) we can push telemetry only (request id, model id, latency). Forwarding prompts requires DPA + product sign-off and will add cost.

rachel.sales: Pricing question: they want SIEM forwarding included. Any ballpark if we include telemetry-only forwarding and a single 3-hour scan window?

marc.se: Ballpark: Dedicated baseline +$11k/mo, one-time provisioning $3.5k, SIEM telemetry forwarding +$800/mo, scan-window setup +$600 one-time for firewall/support. If they want prompt retention or redaction pipeline add $2k+/month.

theo.legal: Action items for contract: add clause for limited vulnerability scan (date/time + IP allowlist), sample prompt sharing under DPA, and non-export of raw user content without explicit agreement.

rachel.sales: OK next steps: 1) Celia to pick pen-test template and confirm if any redlines (ETA 48h). 2) Marc to draft the small sample redaction approach and field map (ETA 24h). 3) Ops to provide presigned upload link & firewall ticket (ops-bot, ETA 2h). 4) I'll send ballpark pricing to customer after numbers confirmed.

celia.security: I'll route to Legal now for signature. If AuroraPSC insists on custom indemnities we escalate.

ops-bot: Firewall ticket opened (#FW-9812). Presigned link will be posted in #eng-infra within 2 hours. :gear:
